title: Moth Control Spray 500ml for Clothes Moths, Fabric & Textile Treatment for Wardrobes, Drawers & Storage, Fast Acting On Contact, Plant-Based Formula for Home Use
bullet_points: Effective Moth Control Around The Home - Designed to target clothes moth activity in wardrobes, drawers and storage areas as part of a regular moth management routine.
Fast Acting On Contact - Works where moths are present, helping you manage activity quickly and efficiently without overcomplicating your routine.
Suitable For Fabrics & Textiles -Use on clothing, curtains, upholstery, linen and other fabric areas. Always test on a small, hidden area before full use.
Ideal For Storage & Living Spaces - Perfect for wardrobes, cupboards, drawers, storage boxes and other areas where clothes moth activity may occur.
Simple To Use Routine - Shake well, spray evenly from a short distance and allow to dry. Reapply as needed to maintain control as part of your ongoing moth defence.
description:
Ready Steady Defend Moth Control Spray is designed to help manage clothes moth activity around the home, making it easier to protect fabrics, clothing and stored items.

Ideal for use in wardrobes, drawers, cupboards and storage areas, this easy-to-use spray fits seamlessly into your regular cleaning and fabric care routine.

Key Features:

  • Designed for clothes moth control in the home
  • Works on contact where moths are present
  • Suitable for fabrics, textiles and soft furnishings
  • Ideal for wardrobes, drawers and storage areas
  • Simple and convenient to use

How to Use:

  1. Shake well before use.
  2. Spray evenly onto affected areas from approximately 20–30cm away.
  3. Allow treated areas to dry before use.
  4. Repeat as required as part of your regular moth management routine.

Important: Always test on an inconspicuous area before wider application. Use only as directed on the product label. Store out of reach of children and pets.
